Game.description: Any SWU-PGN/1.x version string. Spec 18 requires readers to accept a HIGHER minor version and ignore what they do not know, so this must not be pinned to the exact constant "SWU-PGN/1.0". A different major version is rejected.

GameId.description: Opaque and unique per game. MUST NOT be a host-internal identifier (spec §17).

Engine.description: The writer that made the file: product "@" build (spec §5.3, Appendix B.2). The product is the text before the first @, compared exactly.

Date.description: RFC 3339 date-time with a seconds field and an explicit offset (spec §5.1). Writers SHOULD use UTC (Z).

EndDate.description: RFC 3339 date-time with a seconds field and an explicit offset (spec §5.1). Writers SHOULD use UTC (Z).

P1Id.description: Pseudonymous player id: sha256: and 64 lowercase hex digits (spec §17).

Match.description: Opaque match id shared by every game of one match (spec §5.2).

WriterRevision.description: The writer's revision, scoped to the product named before the @ in Engine (spec §5.2). Bumped on every change a reader can observe. Optional and diagnostic for every writer: a file without it is conformant, unless its Engine product is in the pilot writer registry (spec §25), which makes it pre-release.

Undos.description: How many undos the game had. Absent means none. Authoritative: an UNDO record is an ordinary record and a later, deeper rollback can truncate one away, so the count MAY exceed the number of UNDO records in the file.
